message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "O projeto de lei que regula o trabalho dos motoristas de aplicativo deve ser rejeitado?" => Should the bill be rejected? So a "yes" means reject, "no" means not reject (i.e., approve).

Question2: "O Projeto de Lei Complementar nº 12, que regulamenta o trabalho dos motoristas de aplicativo, deve ser aprovado?" => Should the bill be approved? Yes means approve, no means not approve (i.e., reject).

Thus they are opposite polarity: rejecting vs approving same bill. They refer to same bill (project of law regulating work of app drivers). So answering "SIM" to Q1 equals "NÃO" to Q2. So relation OPPOSITE_POLARITY.
